summary: 58-year-old man wrecked his motorcycle in the Owl Creek Pass area near Vista Point, suffering painful rib, ankle and shoulder injuries; ATV evacuation to a CareFlight helicopter to Montrose hospital.
location: Near Vista Point, County Road 8 (Owl Creek Pass area)
notes: Callout 6:50 p.m.; first rescuers on scene 7:45, patient packaged and flown by helicopter from the campground.
